messages.content: Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?

function.name: science_history_get_invention
function.description: Retrieve the inventor and year of invention based on the invention's name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

want_year.description: Return the year of invention if set to true.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?" They want the inventor and year. The theory of relativity is by Albert Einstein. The year? The special theory of relativity was published in 1905. The general theory of relativity was published in 1915. The question likely refers to the theory of relativity in general. But we can answer: Albert Einstein, 1905 (special) and 1915 (general). The user didn't specify special or general. We can mention both. The user might want the year of invention. The function can retrieve the year of invention based on the invention's name. The invention name: "theory of relativity". We can call the function with invention_name: "theory of relativity", want_year: true. But the function likely returns year of invention. But we also need the inventor. The function only returns year. We need to provide inventor manually. So we can call the function to get year. Let's do that.
